Project Summary – Planetary GeoExplorer
Planetary GeoExplorer is an interactive educational website developed for the NASA Challenge, based on the USGS–NASA Planetary Geologic Mapping Program.
The main objective of this project is to make planetary geological information easy to understand and accessible to students, researchers and space enthusiasts.
The website allows users to explore geological maps of five planetary bodies: Mars, Moon, Europa, Mercury and Venus. It includes features such as a Planetary Map Explorer, Geological Feature Explorer, Planet Comparison, Interactive Quiz, Legend Interpreter and Scientific Resource Library.
Users can learn about geological formations such as impact craters, volcanoes, mountains, valleys and plains. They can also compare planetary characteristics, understand geological map symbols and access scientific resources.
The website is developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript to provide a simple, interactive and user-friendly experience.
Overall, Planetary GeoExplorer connects technology and planetary science by transforming complex geological information into an engaging learning experience

Project Details – Planetary GeoExplorer

1. Project Title

Planetary GeoExplorer – Exploring the Geological Wonders of Our Solar System

2. Project Overview

Planetary GeoExplorer is an interactive educational website developed for the NASA Challenge, based on the USGS–NASA Planetary Geologic Mapping Program.

The website provides a simple platform to explore planetary geological maps, understand surface features and learn about the geological history of different celestial bodies.

3. Problem Statement

Planetary geological information is often complex and difficult for beginners to understand. Scientific maps contain technical symbols, colours and geological terms. Information is also distributed across different scientific platforms.

Therefore, there is a need for a user-friendly platform that makes planetary geological information easier to explore and understand

4.Proposed solution

We propose Planetary GeoExplorer, a website that combines planetary maps, geological explanations, comparison tools, educational quizzes and scientific resources in one platform.

It helps students and space enthusiasts learn about planetary geology through an interactive and visually engaging experience.

5. Main Features 1. Planetary Map Explorer: Explore geological maps and information about Mars, Moon, Europa, Mercury and Venus. 2. Geological Feature Explorer: Learn about craters, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, plains and other geological formations. 3. Planet Comparison: Compare planetary bodies based on physical and geological characteristics. 4. Interactive Quiz: Test knowledge through an eight-question planetary geology quiz. 5. Legend Interpreter: Understand the colours, symbols and geological units used in planetary maps. 6. Scientific Resource Library: Access scientific maps, datasets, GIS tools and research references.

6. Technologies Used Technology Purpose HTML Website structure CSS Website design and styling JavaScript Interactive functionality Lovable AI Website development assistance 7. Data Sources NASA – National Aeronautics and Space Administration. USGS – United States Geological Survey. USGS Astrogeology Science Center. Planetary geological maps and scientific datasets.

8. Objectives To make planetary geology easier to understand. To provide access to planetary geological information. To encourage interest in space science. To create an interactive educational experience. To connect web technology with planetary science. 9. Advantages Easy-to-use interface. Interactive learning experience. Multiple planetary bodies in one platform. Easy understanding of geological maps. Access to scientific learning resources.

10. Future Scope Adding more planetary bodies. Introducing 3D planetary surface visualization. Integrating advanced interactive GIS maps. Adding more educational quizzes. Providing updated planetary geological datasets.

11. Expected Outcome The expected outcome is an educational website that simplifies planetary geological information and helps users explore, compare and understand the geological characteristics of different worlds in our solar system. 12. Conclusion Planetary GeoExplorer connects technology, science and education. It transforms complex planetary geological information into an accessible and interactive learning platform. Through this project, we aim to encourage students and space enthusiasts to explore and understand the geological wonders beyond Earth.h​
